default.notes: Linux /proc sampling of harness and descendant processes; task-tree RSS sums count shared pages more than once and can miss between-sample peaks. max_process_rss_kib is OS maximum individual process RSS, not aggregate concurrent memory. Elapsed includes corpus loading/source validation; report wall_seconds also includes on-demand fixture reads but excludes initial validation/build.
